scope.description: Namespace grouping related tasks — a spec directory name, a milestone, a subsystem, or 'default' for projects that don't group at all.

task.description: Task identifier within the scope, e.g. T064, ISSUE-123, or auth-refactor.

status.description: Advisory only. Whatever checklist the project already keeps remains the sole authority for completion — this field never overrides it.

tags.description: Short kebab-case reason codes, free-form vocabulary (unlike event).

related.description: Other task IDs this entry references. Bare form (T036) means same-scope; scope-prefixed form (other-scope/T036) means cross-scope — task IDs commonly collide across scopes, so a bare ID is always resolved against this entry's own `scope` field.

refs.description: File paths, PR references (e.g. 'PR#42'), or commit SHAs. Open-ended, minimally validated.

supersedes.description: Only meaningful on event=correction or event=retracted: the filename of the entry being corrected or retracted.
